user.title: Log in to Tibber
user.description: Use the same e-mail and password as in the Tibber app. This integration uses Tibber's unofficial app API to set the battery level of a vehicle that Tibber has no direct integration with.

vehicle.title: Choose vehicle
vehicle.description: Vehicles without a Tibber integration are usually called "Brand offline" in Tibber, e.g. "Kia offline".

entities.title: Battery level and charging cable
entities.description: Choose where Home Assistant gets the vehicle's battery level, and optionally a sensor showing when the charging cable is plugged in.

data.min_delta: Sync again when the level has changed by
data.refresh_delay: When plugged in, refresh the battery sensor and wait

data_description.soc_entity: For example the battery sensor from your car's integration (Kia, Hyundai, VW, Tesla …).
data_description.plug_entity: A charger status or a binary sensor. Plugging in triggers a sync, which is when Tibber plans charging.
data_description.unplugged_states: Used when the plugged-in sensor is not a binary sensor, e.g. disconnected for Easee.
data_description.only_when_plugged: Changes of the battery level are only sent while the cable is plugged in.
data_description.min_delta: Percentage points. Avoids sending every small change.
data_description.refresh_delay: Seconds. 0 = send right away. Gives the car's integration time to fetch a fresh value.

reauth_confirm.title: Log in to Tibber again
reauth_confirm.description: Tibber did not accept the login for {vehicle}. Enter your e-mail and password again.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Tibber. Try again later.
error.no_vehicles: No vehicles found on the Tibber account. Add the vehicle in the Tibber app first.
error.no_homes: No homes found on the Tibber account.

abort.already_configured: This vehicle is already set up.

data.min_delta: Sync again when the level has changed by
data.refresh_delay: When plugged in, refresh the battery sensor and wait

sync.name: Sync battery level
sync.description: Sends the vehicle's battery level to Tibber now.

level.name: Battery level
level.description: Optional. Send this level instead of the sensor's value.
